wpPortfolio.title: The Signature Auctions
wpPortfolio.content: I created a bespoke WordPress auction website for a sports memorabilia company in April 2020, where visitors can bid or buy the company’s items. The site uses Woocommerce, Stripe and Paypal to enable purchases, connects to a customised auction plugin and is designed using Bootstrap.
